full_page.content:
1946, October 31
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten orig- inal by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
"O all ye works of the Lord! Praise the Lord. .
October 31, Halloween 1946
Dear Brother Leo:
God bless you and all. Many thanks for the kind favor received in best of condition a few days ago. . . .
We got home that night just as they were starting supper . Deo Gr .!
Love to all. Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap. Praised be Jesus Christ.
